WITH project_rates AS (
  SELECT
    s.arcref AS project_reference,
    p.fundflux AS funding_source,
    AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS size_per_minute_rate
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN projects AS p
    ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(size_per_minute_rate) AS average_project_rate
  FROM project_rates
)
SELECT
  pr.project_reference,
  pr.funding_source,
  pr.size_per_minute_rate,
  pr.size_per_minute_rate - b.average_project_rate AS gap_above_benchmark
FROM project_rates AS pr
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE pr.size_per_minute_rate > b.average_project_rate
ORDER BY gap_above_benchmark DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A project's rate is the plain average of gbsize / spanmin across its matching scans; scans with NULL values or zero duration do not contribute. The benchmark is the plain average of the resulting rates across projects.
